responsibility: Implements cleanup and simplification of the tree/GIMPLE CFG after transformations. It removes unreachable and redundant edges and blocks, folds constant control expressions, canonicalizes switches and conditional exits, merges forwarders and compatible blocks, repairs PHIs and call-control flags, deletes unreachable code while updating cgraph/clones when needed, and provides the late optimized-CFG cleanup pass used before RTL expansion as well as helper passes that merge trivial PHI forwarding structure.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual tree CFG cleanup transformations behind gcc/tree-cfgcleanup.h, such as folding control flow, removing unreachable or redundant edges/blocks, merging forwarders/PHIs, and running the cleanup passes; the header only exposes the entry points and shared bitmap/state.
